༄༅/ /rdo rje g.yu sgron ma'i sgrub thabs zla ba 'dod 'jo bzhugs so/ /rin chen shog 'dra/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rdo rje g.yu sgron ma'i sgrub thabs zla ba

'dod 'jo bzhugs so/ / rin chen shog 'dra/ rdo rje g.yu sgron ma'i sgrub thabs zla ba 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yid bzhin re ba kun 'grub cing*/ 'dod dgu'i bsam pa rdzogs mdzad pa/ /ye shes mtsho rgyal la btud de/ /rdo rje g.yu sgron sgrub thabs bshad/ /'di la phyin nang gsang ba gsum/ /phyi ltar sman btsun mched lnga la/ /nang ltar yid 'ongs lha mo lnga/ / gsang bar mkha' 'gro lnga yin pas/ /sku gsung thugs yin 'di ltar bsgrub/ /dang po phyi ltar sgrub pa ni/ /yid dang mthun pa'i gangs ri'am/ / nags ri spang ri skyed mos tshal/ /dben zhing nyams dga'i gnas nyid du/ / maṇḍal padma 'dab bzhi'i steng/ /sman mo'i gzugs dang me long mda'/ /dar sna lngas brgyan gzhag par bya/ /mtha' skor dkar gsum mngar gsum dang*/ /me tog la sogs mchod pa bshams/ /de nas rang nyid skad cig gis/ /padma 'byung gnas bsgom byas la/ /mdun du gangs ri skyed mos tshal/ /dbus na rin chen khang bzang ste/ /de nang rin chen khri steng du/ /rdo rje g.yu sgron dkar gsal ni/ /dar dkar na bza' gser g.yus brgyan/ / phyag g.yas yid bzhin nor bu ste/ /g.yon du dngul dkar me long 'dzin/ / dar thod me long phreng rgyan can/ /'dzum bcas phyed krung 'od zer 'phro/ / phyogs bzhir mched bzhi gtso mo 'dra/ /kun kyang bcu drug na tshod la/ /sgeg mdzes dgyes pa'i tshul du bsgom/ /snying ga'i 'od zer rab 'phros pas/ / gnam sman gangs ri lha yi gnas/ /sprin dkar dag pa'i pho brang nas/ /ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs bstim/ dngos dang yid kyis mchod byas la/ / sngags 'di ma yengs bzlas par bya/ /āoṃ badzra pra mo ha hring hring swā hā/ /bdag nyid padma'i 'od zer ni/ /phog pas de dag sku gsung thugs/ /dgyes pas rin chen char 'bebs shing*/ /'dod dgu'i bsam pa bsgrub par bsam/ / rjes la dkar gsum mngar gsum gyi/

/gtor ma 'bru gsum byin brlabs la/ /āoṃ badzra pra mo ha bha liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa lnga 'am bdun gyis dbul/ /bstod pa 'di yang brjod par bya/ /rdo rje g.yu sgron shin tu mdzes pa'i sku/ /dkar gsal gangs ri'i ngos la nyi shar 'dra/ /sgrub pa po la dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad/ /mched lnga 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sngon tshe slob dpon padma'i spyan lnga ru/ /ji ltar zhal bzhes thugs dam dran mdzod la/ rnal 'byor bdag la dgyes pa'i zhal bzang ston/ / bcol pa'i phrin las myur du 'grub par mdzod/ /ces brjod dgyes pas don 'grub bsam/ /thun mtshams spyod lam ci bder bya/ /de ltar zhag bdun bsgrubs pa yis/ /rmi lam sngar bas 'gyur zhing dga'/ /bud med 'du dang zas ster dang*/ /phyag dang bskor ba byed pa rmi/ /dngos grub zas nor sprin bzhin 'du/ khyad par bud med bzang mo dang*/ /yul mi mang po 'du ba yin/ /'dod don thun mong dngos grub thob/ /de ni phyi ltar sgrub pa'o/ athi+-i/ rgya rgya rgya// //gnyis pa nang ltar sgrub pa ni/ /gnas dang dkyil 'khor sngon bzhin te/ khyad par za 'og khug ma ru/ /shel dang byi ru g.yu chung gzhug /bla rdo lha mo mched lnga ni/ /dmar mdzes me long padma bsnams/ /dar zab rin chen sna tshogs brgyan/ /phyed krung 'dzum bcas 'od zer 'phro/ /tshangs pa lha yi 'jig rten nas/ /ye shes spyan drangs gnyis med bstim/ /mchod dang bstod pas mnyes byas la/ /bdag nyid nyi ma 'od zer gyi/ /thugs ka'i 'od kyis bskul ba yis/ /'jig rten skye bo zas nor bcas/ /skad cig dbang gis sdud par bsam/ /āoṃ hrī badzra pra mo ha hring hring sdus sdus a kar sha ya khug dzaḥ/ sgom dang bzlas pa'i 'od zer gyis/ /stong gsum 'od dmar gcig gyur nas/ /rang la thim zhing 'dus par bsam/ /lha mo mched lnga'i 'od zer las/ /sprul pa'i lha mo dpag med 'phros/

/thams cad dbang bsdus bkug par bsam/ khyad par gang dmigs bsgrub bya ni/ /skad gcig bkug nas dbang gyur bsam/ /rjes la ci 'byor gtor mas mchod/ /bstod pa 'di yang brjod par bya/ /tshangs pa lha yi 'jig rten na/ /lha mo me tog man dhā ra/ /dpag med lha yi bstod pa ni/ /'jig rten gsum dbang mdzad pa mo/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /ji ltar bdag gis bsams pa bzhin/ /'dod dgu'i re ba 'grub par mdzod/ /ces brjod thun mtshams ci bder gnas/ /rmi lam skye bo dpag med 'du/ /nyi zla'i steng gnas lha yul 'gro/ /bud med 'du dang gter 'don rmi/ /dngos su gang dmigs dbang du 'du/ /kun gyi yid 'phrog skye bo 'du/ /dbang gi dngos grub rgya chen thob/ /de ni nang ltar sgrub pa'o/ athi+-i/ rgya rgya rgya// //gsum pa gsang bar sgrub pa ni/ /dben zhing yid dang rjes mthun par/ /maṇḍal 'dab bzhi dkar ser dmar/ /ljang dang lte ba mthing ga'i steng*/ /thod pa bdud rtsis bkang ba'i steng*/ /me long chos 'byung sum brtsegs nang*/ /hrī ha ri ni sa lo ka sarba siddhi pha la khug dzaḥ zhes pa dang ni phyi rol la/ / yul dang skye bo'i spel tshig bri/ /de nyid mkha' 'gro lngar bskyed de/ /hrīḥ las dbus su ḍā ki ma/ /dmar nag spyi gtsug rin chen tog /phag zhal mche gtsigs gcer bu la/ /g.yas g.yon gri gug thod khrag 'dzin/ / g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang rus pas brgyan/ /gru mo kha ṭwāṃ mtshan pa la/ / phyogs bzhir ha ri ni sa las/ /gtso mo 'dra ba'i 'khor bskyed do/ /kun gyi snying khar pad zla dang*/ /nyi steng hṝḥdamar tsheg drag can/ /ha ri ni sas bskor ba las/ /'od zer 'phro ba bsgom par bya/ /rang nyid padma thod phreng ni/ /mthing nag 'jigs pa'i 'od zer gyis/ /'og min ye shes bkug la bstim/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pas mchod/ /sngags 'di ma yengs bzlas par bya/ /āoṃ hrī ha ri ni sa lo ka siddhi a karṣa ya khug khug sdus sdus dza dza tsitta hring hring*/

bdag gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis/ /mkha' 'gro la phog bskul ma thag /mkha' 'gro'i 'od zer rab 'phros pas/ /'jig rten skye bo'i zas nor dang*/ /gang dmigs bsgrub bya bkug par bsam/ /yang cig 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis/ /'dzam gling khyom khyom mer mer la/ /rgyal po la sogs bkug par bsam/ /yang cig 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis/ /nam mkha' rgya mtsho rnga lpags la/ khor yug rnga chen gcig gyur pa/ /nyi zla'i rnga yog gis brdungs pas/ /bdag gi grags pa'i rnga sgra yis/ /'jig rten gsum po kun grags nas/ /g.yo ldeg med zhing khyom pa yis/ /bdag gi dbang du 'dusapar bsam/ /sngags dang ting 'dzin ma yengs pas/ /zhag bdun bar du bsgrub par bya/ /rmi lam khrom du skye bos bstod/ /zas nor char 'bab mkha' la 'gro/ /gter dang rin chen rnyed pa dang*/ dung 'bud rnga chen brdung ba rmi/ /dngos su 'gro kun dbang du 'du/ /che btsun thams cad 'du ba dang*/ /zas nor gter ni rdol ba bzhin/ /phyogs rnams kun nas 'du ba yin/ /de ltar grub pa'i rtags byung nas/ /me long yi ge bdud rtsis bkru/ /thod pa'i bdud rtsi'i 'od zer gyis/ /'jig rten gsum po 'od du zhu/ /thod pa'i nang thim dmigs nas ni/ /bdag nyid btung bas dngos grub thob/ /gsang sgrub yid bzhin nor bu 'di/ /sgom dang bzlas pa tsam gyis ni/ /thams cad 'du zhing zas nor 'phel/ /ci bsam 'grub dang chos 'phel lo/ de ltar bsgrubs pa'i dam tshig tu/ /chags zhen mi bya sbyin par gtang*/ /bla ma la gus dam tshig bsrung*/ /rig pa ngar bskyed brtul zhugs bya/ /gtum mo sbar zhing bde stong bsgom/ /des ni myur du 'grub pa yin/ athi+-i/ rgya rgya rgya// //yang gsang bla na med pa 'di/ /rang nyid padma'i thugs ka ru/ /hrī dang ha ri ni sa las/ /mthing nag bde chen phag mo ni/ /phag zhal gcig ste spyan gsum bsgrad/ /gri gug thod pa ka ṭwāṃ 'dzin/

/gar byed 'od zer dpag med 'phro/ /phyogs bzhir de 'dra'i 'khor bzhi bsams/ /kun gyi thugs ka'i nyi zla las/ hrī dang ha ri ni sa bsam/ /de la 'od 'phros snod bcud bsdus/ / slar 'dus snying ga'i hrī la thim/ /steng 'og rlung ni kha sbyar te/ spro bsdu'i dmigs pa sngar bzhin las/ khyad par sna bug g.yas pa nas/ /rlung ni lcags kyu zhags pa yis/ /thams cad 'od zhu tshur 'dus nas/ /sna bug g.yon nas snying gar thim/ /lus khengs bde dang stong par bsgom/ /rjes la chos kun rang gi sems/ /sems nyid ye stong spros dang bral/ /ma skyes nam mkha'i rang bzhin du/ /mi bsgom mi bskyed rang sar gzhag/mnyam nyid ye shes gdod ma'i ngang*/ /rtsa ba bral ba'i rang bzhin du/ /ye shes rlung gis mthar phyin te/ /bde chen sa la mya ngan 'das/ /'di ni rdzogs pa'i rim pa ste/ /mchog gi go 'phang myur du thob/ /snga ma gsum ni bskyed pa ste/ /thun mong dngos grub char bzhin 'bab/ /de ltar bsgom shes rnal 'byor la/ / 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa kun/ /ji ltar bskyed rim bsgoms kyang 'dra/ /snying po'i rdzogs rim kha lo bas/ /legs bsgyur thar pa'i grong du 'gro/ /gzhan yang 'khor 'das mnyam pa nyid/ /ji ltar bsgoms kyang blo las 'das/ /de ltar rtogs te 'khor bar grol/ /de phyir rdo rje g.yu sgron gyi/ /bskyed dang rdzogs pa'i rim gnyis kyi/ /thar lam 'bras bur rab sbyin pas/ /skal ldan rnams dang 'phrad par shog /shin tu yang zab mkha' 'gro'i gnad/ /bde chen dngos grub gnyis stsol ba/ /de 'dra rgyal sras padma'i lugs/ /gang de dri med 'od zer gyis/ /gcig tu bsdus pa zab mo'i don/ /ston gsum gangs ri thod dkar ru/ /legs sbyar dge bas 'gro ba kun/ /rgyal ba'i go 'phang thob par shog /'di ni rtsa gnas 'khor lo las/ /yi ge bsdu ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /skal bzang don du gsal bar byas/

/gnad 'dis myur du 'grub pa yin/ /dpal rdo rje g.yu sgron ma'i sgrub thabs zla ba 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba/ o rgyan chen po padma 'byung gnas kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i rnal 'byor pa dri med 'od zer gyis/ ston gsum me tog dang 'bras bu smin pa'i tshe/ gangs ri thod dkar gyi mgul o rgyan rdzong gi gnas su sbyar ba rdzogs so// dge'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen bka' 'bum/ (8)rdo rje g.yu sgron ma'i sgrub thabs zla ba 'dod 'jo/ -PAGE 358--PAGE 359--PAGE 356-
